record.paper_title: 20 Open Questions About Deformations of Compactifiable Manifolds
record.original_question: Let X be obtained from a complex manifold X~ by removing finitely many points. How do deformations of X compare with deformations of the compact or less punctured space X~?

evidence.quote: Question 19. Let X be obtained from X˜ by removing finitely many points. Compare deformations of X to those of X˜.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\widetilde{X}$ be a complex manifold (for instance, compact, or non-compact with fewer punctures), and let $X = \widetilde{X} \setminus \{p_1, \dots, p_n\}$ be the complex manifold obtained by removing finitely many points $p_1, \dots, p_n \in \widetilde{X}$. Consider the deformation functors $\mathrm{Def}_X$ and $\mathrm{Def}_{\widetilde{X}}$ classifying isomorphism classes of flat families of complex structures over Artinian (or analytic germ) bases that specialize at the closed point to $X$ and $\widetilde{X}$, respectively, together with their associated Kodaira–Spencer cohomology $H^1(X, T_X)$, $H^1(\widetilde{X}, T_{\widetilde{X}})$ and obstruction spaces $H^2(X, T_X)$, $H^2(\widetilde{X}, T_{\widetilde{X}})$.

Describe the relationship between $\mathrm{Def}_X$ and $\mathrm{Def}_{\widetilde{X}}$. In particular:

(a) Construct the natural restriction morphism $\mathrm{Def}_{\widetilde{X}} \to \mathrm{Def}_X$ (when one exists) and determine its kernel and image.

(b) Identify which deformations of $X$ extend across the punctures $p_1, \dots, p_n$ to deformations of $\widetilde{X}$, and characterize the obstructions to such extensions in terms of local cohomology at the points $p_i$.

(c) Compare the tangent and obstruction spaces $H^i(X, T_X)$ and $H^i(\widetilde{X}, T_{\widetilde{X}})$ for $i = 1, 2$, taking into account the local cohomology long exact sequence supported at $\{p_1, \dots, p_n\}$.
artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution of the comparison between deformations of a complex manifold and of its puncturing at finitely many points was found. The question is posed as one of a list of open questions on deformations of compactifiable manifolds, and standard references on deformation theory of complex manifolds do not address this specific comparison.

status_evidence.title: Lectures on deformations of complex manifolds (Manetti)
status_evidence.snippet: Foundational lectures on deformation theory of compact complex manifolds; no treatment of punctured-vs-unpunctured comparison.
status_evidence.claim: Standard deformation theory references do not directly address this comparison.

status_evidence.title: Puncture (topology) - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Defines puncturing as removing a finite set of points from a manifold.
status_evidence.claim: Provides the standard notion of puncturing used in the problem.
